dedupe_keys.name: uk sewage map downstream overflow model

description: UK Sewage Map combines live event-duration monitoring reports with a basic hydrological routing model. It identifies river reaches downstream of recent or active combined sewer overflows and displays them on a map. Users supply or retrieve outfall events and river network geometry; output is a near-real-time indication of potentially affected non-tidal reaches. The repository description names UK coverage, while its metadata also says the current map is limited to the Thames basin; this narrower verified coverage should govern use. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing. A limitation is that routed exposure does not quantify concentration, dilution, discharge volume or health risk. Monitoring and network gaps can also hide affected reaches. The model can help construct wastewater incident scenarios for water-quality simulations. The related catalogue EPANET record models drinking-water pipes, not river routing of sewage spills. No live events or map layers were downloaded.
inputs: Overflow events and non-tidal river network
name: UK Sewage Map downstream overflow model
notes: G7 G7-1694. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability. Repository metadata says Thames-basin current coverage despite broader UK aim; this draft uses the narrow coverage.
outputs: Downstream reaches potentially affected by active spills
